summary: Iteration 11: end-to-end verification of Stripe Identity automated KYC (driver). All 5 backend scenarios + 2 frontend scenarios from review request pass. New regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_identity_kyc_review.py (7/7) plus existing /app/backend/tests/test_identity_kyc.py (3/3 when run from /app/backend with server on path) and /app/backend/tests/test_driver_onboarding_kyc.py (3/3) all pass. Frontend Playwright validated the /driver/verification/callback page (identity-callback-page + identity-pending + identity-dashboard-btn) and Admin Panel Approvals tab (approval-kyc-<id> badge showing 'requires_input' alongside existing approve/reject buttons and document view).

minor.issue: Test imports 'server' directly; needs to be run with cwd=/app/backend (it is when invoked via the project Makefile/CI from backend dir). Fails with ModuleNotFoundError when invoked from /app. Cosmetic test-runner config issue, not a product bug. Mitigation: add 'pythonpath = backend' to pytest.ini, or run from /app/backend.
Pre-existing 500s (ObjectId not JSON serializable) carried over from iteration_9/10. Out of scope for this iteration.

action_items: (Optional) Add 'pythonpath = backend' to /app/pytest.ini so test_apply_identity_result_auto_approves passes when invoked from repo root.
(Carry-over from iter10, optional) Exclude Mongo _id from /api/drivers/me, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/orders responses.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py start_identity_verification correctly 400s when no driver application exists, creates a real Stripe Identity VerificationSession (test mode), persists session_id + status='requires_input' under driver.identity_verification.
get_identity_status reconciles via stripe.identity.VerificationSession.retrieve and calls _apply_identity_result; auto-promotes user to driver only on status='verified' — verified by unit test.
Pending gating intact: PUT /api/drivers/status?status=online → 403 until admin approves (or auto-verified). /auth/me remains user_type='customer' during identity flow.
_flatten_pending exposes the full driver doc (with _id popped) under 'raw', so AdminPanel can read row.raw.identity_verification.status to render the approval-kyc-<id> badge.
Admin manual fallback admin_approve_driver still flips status=active AND user_type=driver atomically — confirmed by post-approve /auth/me + online toggle 200.
IdentityVerificationCallback polls /api/drivers/identity/status and renders 4 distinct status cards (loading/verified/pending/review) with consistent dashboard navigation button.
AdminPanel.js Approvals tab renders KYC badge with stripe identity status next to docs/approve/reject controls — verified visually.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 review tests + 3/3 existing identity tests + 3/3 KYC doc upload tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (callback page + admin approvals KYC badge both verified)

test_credentials: Created fresh users per run with @gmail.com domain: rev_*_<ts>@gmail.com (customer applicants) and rev_*_adm_<ts>@gmail.com (admins), password Test1234! / Admin1234!. JWT in Authorization header / localStorage.token.
seed_data_creation: Per-test fresh customer/admin/driver applications. Real Stripe Identity test sessions were created against verify.stripe.com (test mode) — they remain incomplete (requires_input).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 backend + 2 frontend review-request scenarios pass. Completing Stripe-hosted doc+selfie flow cannot be automated (external domain). Auto-approve-on-verified path is covered by the existing unit test test_apply_identity_result_auto_approves. Pre-existing /api/drivers/me + /api/admin/users + /api/admin/orders 500s (ObjectId) are unrelated and still open.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no in-scope bugs. test_apply_identity_result_auto_approves ModuleNotFoundError is a pytest path issue when running from /app; running from /app/backend resolves it. Adding [tool.pytest.ini_options] pythonpath = ['backend'] (or pytest.ini equivalent) would normalize this.
